name: FX Inline
description: FX Inline converts prices directly on webpages into your preferred currency, so you can compare costs without leaving the page.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://open.er-api.com https://api.exchangerate-api.com
